title: Survey reveals Wall Street firms are linking bonuses and promotions to AI competency among employees
description: As artificial intelligence reshapes the landscape of Wall Street, its expertise is increasingly tied to salary and promotions in financial firms. Currently, about 25 per cent of these companies are tying employee pay to their AI competencies. Moreover, 30 per cent are asking for evidence of AI tool application in performance assessments. This reflects a significant evolution in how the finance sector values tech-oriented skills.
